title: Equal view counts under perfect privacy
statement: Let $P$ be a type, let $\Gamma$ be an access structure on finite subsets of $P$, and let $S$ be a secret-sharing scheme with secret type $\mathrm{Secret}$, share type $\mathrm{Share}$, and randomness type $\mathrm{Rand}$. Suppose $S$ has perfect privacy for $\Gamma$. For any unauthorized finite subset $B\subseteq P$, any two secrets $\mathrm{sec},\mathrm{sec}'$, and any assignment $w:P\to\mathrm{Share}$, the sets of random choices producing view $w$ on $B$ under the two secrets have equal cardinalities.
hypotheses_covered: A scheme $S$ with secret, share, and randomness types
